E1.evidence: Reporter (a PX4 maintainer) gives the command "roslaunch px4 multi_uav_mavros_sitl.launch" on ROS Melodic, mavros 0.29.2, and the log "RLException: error loading <rosparam> tag: could not determine a constructor for the tag '!degrees' in \"<string>\", line 63, column 27: angular_velocity_stdev: !degrees 0.02"; mavros maintainer confirms: "Looks like something changed into yaml library. Previously roslaunch provide `degrees` tag, that simply converts value to radians." -- https://github.com/mavlink/mavros/issues/1210

E2.evidence: Units: the PyYAML library and ros_comm's roslaunch/rosparam Python packages, which call it. The reporter's log shows the failing call is in roslaunch ("/opt/ros/melodic/lib/python2.7/dist-packages/roslaunch/loader.py:412: YAMLLoadWarning: calling yaml.load() without Loader=... is deprecated" ... "data = yaml.load(text)"), and the `!degrees` constructor is registered by rosparam with "yaml.add_constructor(u'!degrees', construct_angle_degrees)" (ros_comm 1.14.3 tools/rosparam/src/rosparam/__init__.py line 635). PyYAML 3.13 declares "def load(stream, Loader=Loader):" and "def add_constructor(tag, constructor, Loader=Loader):"; PyYAML 5.1 declares "def load(stream, Loader=None):" with "if Loader is None: load_warning('load'); Loader = FullLoader" but keeps "def add_constructor(tag, constructor, Loader=Loader):", so a constructor registered through the default add_constructor is not seen by the default load. PyYAML maintainers (5.2 CHANGES): "Repair incompatibilities introduced with 5.1. The default Loader was changed, but several methods like add_constructor still used the old default". The failure depends on the consumer's assumption about the provider's API declarations, so it is not internal; the resolving changes are code changes (ros_comm PR #1688, PyYAML 5.2 PR #287), not deployment wiring or build-only changes (pinning PyYAML 3.13 is a workaround that reverts the provider's interface change).

E3.evidence: UPGRADE: PyYAML 5.1 (provider) installed under ROS Melodic's ros_comm, whose calls match the pre-5.1 declarations. PX4 issue 11662: "I solved the issue by downgrading PyYAML from 5.1 to 3.13 manually" and "I can confirm that downgrading PyYAML from 5.1 to 3.13 works"; ros_comm issue 1686: "this won't happen when using pyyaml from the Ubuntu repositories, since that's currently still version 3.12."

E4.evidence: Observed launch failure: "RLException: error loading <rosparam> tag: could not determine a constructor for the tag '!degrees'" -- https://github.com/mavlink/mavros/issues/1210

units.name: PyYAML
units.revision_basis: The mavros reporter does not state the PyYAML version, but his log contains the YAMLLoadWarning that PyYAML introduced in 5.1 (absent from 3.13's lib/yaml/__init__.py), and the linked threads name the version: "downgrading PyYAML from 5.1 to 3.13" (PX4 issue 11662) and "Downgrading PyYAML from 5.1 to 3.13 could be an option" (PX4 PR 12266). Tag 5.1 (e471e86b); 5.1.1/5.1.2 are Cython re-releases with the same load/add_constructor declarations. The chosen resolution (ros_comm PR #1688) leaves PyYAML unchanged, so resolved_rev stays 5.1.

units.name: ros_comm
units.revision_basis: Consumer code is tools/roslaunch (loader.py, the yaml.load call in the log) and tools/rosparam (the !degrees constructor registration that roslaunch imports: "lazy import: we have to import rosparam in oder to to configure the YAML constructors"); both ship from ros_comm at one version and are treated as one consumer unit here. Reporter uses the Melodic binaries (/opt/ros/melodic/lib/python2.7/dist-packages/roslaunch/loader.py) on 2019-04-03 but names no version; the ros_comm Melodic releases bracketing that date are tag 1.14.3 (2018-08-06) and 1.14.4 (2020-02-21), so the installed release was 1.14.3 (inferred), whose loader.py line 412 is "data = yaml.load(text)", matching the log line number. Resolved revision: merge commit 29053c48 of ros_comm PR #1688 into melodic-devel (2019-04-23), first released in 1.14.4.

failed_conditions.quote: Repair incompatibilities introduced with 5.1. The default Loader was changed, but several methods like add_constructor still used the old default

loudness_evidence: roslaunch aborts with a launch error: "RLException: error loading <rosparam> tag: could not determine a constructor for the tag '!degrees'" preceded by "YAMLLoadWarning: calling yaml.load() without Loader=... is deprecated, as the default Loader is unsafe." -- https://github.com/mavlink/mavros/issues/1210

resolution.summary: Consumer-side adaptation in ros_comm PR #1688 (merge 29053c48 on melodic-devel): roslaunch's loader.py changes "data = yaml.load(text)" to "data = yaml.safe_load(text)" (and rosparam load_str to yaml.safe_load_all), and rosparam additionally registers "yaml.SafeLoader.add_constructor(u'!degrees', construct_angle_degrees)" (plus !radians, binary and the implicit resolvers) so the loader used by the call has the constructors.
resolution.evidence: Diff of https://github.com/ros/ros_comm/pull/1688 (merged 2019-04-23, "Fixes #1686"); none of the linked threads shows ros_comm at this revision running with PyYAML 5.1. Working compositions actually reported are workarounds: reverting the provider ("I can confirm that downgrading PyYAML from 5.1 to 3.13 works" -- https://github.com/PX4/PX4-Autopilot/issues/11662, ros_comm revision not stated) and removing the tag from mavros's configs (mavros PR #1261). The provider-side fix is PyYAML 5.2 ("https://github.com/yaml/pyyaml/pull/287 -- Change default loader for yaml.add_constructor"), whose add_constructor with no Loader registers on Loader, FullLoader and UnsafeLoader.

notes: Three packages are involved: mavros's launch config (px4_config.yaml, apm_config.yaml, px4flow_config.yaml use the rosparam-provided `!degrees` tag), ros_comm's roslaunch/rosparam (implement the tag through PyYAML), and PyYAML. The spec takes PyYAML<->ros_comm as the composition because the mavros maintainer places the break there ("it looks like that roslaunch should be updated to handle pyyaml changes") and mavros's use of the documented tag is not what changed. The packet's fixes are workarounds in other compositions: mavros PR #1261 (merge 881cda6a, 2019-06-27) replaces "angular_velocity_stdev: !degrees 0.02" with "angular_velocity_stdev: 0.0003490659 // 0.02 degrees" and "ranger_fov: !degrees 6.8" with "ranger_fov: 0.118682"; PX4 PR #12266 (merge 959a35b3) only updates the CI docker image tag px4io/px4-dev-ros-kinetic:2019-03-08 -> 2019-07-29 and adds a safe-landing CI test (the PR discussion shows PX4 CI hitting the same error with updated containers). The YAMLLoadWarning in the log is a second documented symptom of the same api:yaml.load declaration change. The same PyYAML change also affects api:yaml.load_all used by rosparam load_str, not exercised in the reporter's log. consumer_built_against 3.13 is inferred from ros_comm's calls matching 3.13's declarations (3.12, the Ubuntu 18.04 package, has the same ones); the resolved label 5.1 reflects that PR #1686/#1688 were written against PyYAML 5.1.
